Call Python function to register user
Call Py function to get leaderboard
Query to update DB with new score
Query to update DB with new user
Call Python function to upload score
DATA FLOW: From top left to bottom right.
1. Typing Test Game is divided into four modules - Main Game, Interface_py, Python, Database.
2. The first two modules are written in C, with Python serving as the mediator and MySQL as the database server.
3. err_code indicates whether a call to a higher module function was successful,failed or encountered another known or unknown error.
4. Three text files(sentences.txt, score.txt, leaderboard.txt) are used to share data between module 2 and 3.
